fusions.name: Spat Seed
fusions.desc: Costs 5% of your maximum health. Spits a seed that deals 8 nature damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. 25% of the damage dealt returns to you as healing over 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Spore Burst
fusions.desc: Looses a cone of spores that deals 8 damage to everything caught in it. Your afflictions on each target spread to enemies within 4 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Kitchen Garden
fusions.desc: Raises a garden where you stand. For 10 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally inside it.

fusions.name: Sproutling Helper
fusions.desc: Calls a bonded familiar of nature that fights beside you, striking for 3 damage. Each kill restores 3 health to you.
